# WHAT WE WANT They sold our parents the frontier as a fresh start. They signed the contract, worked off the passage, and stepped off the dropship into a debt that grew faster than any wage. Company housing. Company store. Company doctor. Company air, metered by the litre, billed by the shift.
We were told to be grateful. We are done being grateful.
## XIBOU In 2164 Colonial Marines went into Xibou and thousands of colonists did not come out. Then the reports were lost, the names were sealed and the officers were promoted. The United Americas called it an incident. We call it the reason we exist.
## WHAT WE DEMAND - [bold]Self rule.[/bold] {colony} is governed by the people who breathe its air, not by an administrator appointed from an office a hundred light years away. - [bold]Every indenture cancelled.[/bold] Not reduced. Not renegotiated. Torn up. - [bold]The garrison goes home.[/bold] Their rifles point at us, never at anything that threatens us. - [bold]The works belong to the workers.[/bold] The processors, the mines, the pharmacy and the landing pad belong to the hands that keep them running. - [bold]The truth about Xibou.[/bold] Every name of the dead. Every name of the men who gave the order.
## WHAT WE ARE The UA and the Empire call us terrorists, because a word is cheaper than an answer. We are miners, medics, cooks, welders and teachers. We are not one army with one general. We are a hundred cells on a hundred rocks, and nobody commands all of us. That is why they cannot kill all of us.
We do not want your pity. We want our planet.
